en-US.title: Drip Fantasy
en-US.subtitle: Fantasy football, live
en-US.description:
Fantasy football where the week is a game you watch, not a number you refresh.

Assign each player to a game-time window and pair him with a hidden scoring metric. Your opponent does the same, sealed. When the games kick off the picks reveal and the effects fire live: nukes wipe a slot to zero, catches erase the last ten minutes of your opponent's drip, a hot streak doubles your rate. A slot is won by whoever is ahead when its games end.

Or play it straight. Classic leagues score the way your league always has — your scoring settings, your lineup, your rules — with everything else here anyway.

RUN A REAL LEAGUE
· Dynasty, keeper and redraft, contracts and a salary cap, auctions, superflex, IDP, best ball, guillotine, and more formats than you will use.
· Trades with a league vote, offer expiry, counters, FAAB and up to eight teams in one deal.
· Waivers with FAAB or rolling priority, a minimum bid, free-agency windows, and conditional claims — "if I miss on him, take the other one".
· A commissioner's console that does not run out: co-commissioners, locks, the waiver order, score edits, dues, and the league's own weekly awards and badges.
· A record book that fills itself — champions, all-time manager lines, the biggest weeks anybody has had.

LIVE
Real play-by-play, live scoring, a play feed, and notifications when something happens to your team.

Import a league from Sleeper, ESPN, Yahoo, Fleaflicker or MyFantasyLeague, or start a native one here.
en-US.promoText: Hidden picks, live effects, and a commissioner's console that does not run out.

advisory.//: Simulated gambling is FALSE deliberately: drip coin is earned in play, buys power-ups, and cannot be cashed out or bought with money. If that ever changes, this answer changes with it.
